fixes.explanation: That's it, baker. "…Abraham gave gifts to the sons of his concubines…" while he was still alive, and then he sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east (Genesis 25:6). Gifts first, then the goodbye. The text doesn't say what the gifts were, so I won't guess.

Yes, baker! "After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac…" (Genesis 25:11). Abraham had been blessed by the LORD too (Genesis 24:1), and now Isaac gets his own. I think that's a good way to find out the story isn't ending when the funeral does. The verse says Isaac lived near Beer-lahai-roi. Try saying that name three times fast. I can't, and I've had a whole drawer's worth of practice talking to myself.
